title: The Shadow of What Was Lost
author: James Islington
review:
Read about 60% of this, don't want to finish. This series isn't for me. It's decent but nothing about it is that interesting to me and for the most part aside from some twists is fairly standard fantasy genre fare. Reminds me the most of Stormlight Archive and the Lord of the Rings. Has a lot of the things that make Sanderson not click with me.

If I had read this as one of my first fantasy series would probably have been more interested. The writing overall is fairly amateur, the dialog is pretty awkward, and the characters are thin. I'm not as driven by the plot of books so much as the quality of the writing, characters, and the world so this one doesn't have what I'm looking for.
